note: Baseline for the benchmark gate's environment-calibration probe. Maintainers own this file. environmentKey() in packages/verify/src/gates/bench.ts derives each key from CI mode, platform, architecture, and core count. An unlisted host records its probe and key without an environment verdict. See docs/adr/0007-calibrate-the-benchmark-host-before-judging-timing.md for the five-run median procedure.
